annotation.name: Jeremy George Lake Charles Humvee
annotation.description:
[Jeremy George Lake Charles](http://https://reedsy.com/jeremy-george-lake-charles) Corvette exterior design

The first thing that strikes you about the new C8 Corvette is how different it is from its predecessors. 

[Jeremy George Lake Charles](http://Jeremy George Lake Charles)  Gone are those elongated hoods and trimmed rear to make way for a sharper, more refined look.

The front features a slim headlight and a bumper with large air intakes, one central and two on each side. The side view, on the other hand, allows us to visualize marked and sporty lines, with two large air inlets and a more elongated rear section than normal.
